## Historical audit: S0102, visible chunk 1 of 4

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r2/generic_rsi/C2/development/commons_109923183/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file and source ID S0102. The reference and rendered images are not visible in the supplied observations.

| Evidence | Observation and limit |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, line 1 | The stated goal was an editable, single-view indoor reconstruction with matching geometry, viewpoint, materials and framing. The student was instructed to build and inspect a render under a limited execution budget. |
| Student `model_response`, line 3; `execute` step 1, line 4 | The student produced and executed a nonempty first-build program. Its **interpretation**, not independently verified image content, was a chaise room with pillow, card, wall, curtain, parquet and cropped chair. Separate assets and nested chaise parts represent multiple objects, filled panels, trim and supports. The pillow and its piping receive matching rotations; hierarchy and coordinates alone do not verify physical contact or pose. |
| Student `model_response`, line 3 | The code specifies parquet board colors, fabric and cane shaders, semantic-descendant material targeting, a camera hypothesis, ambient world and two area lights. These are implemented choices, not evidence that texture scale, assignments, camera, lighting or appearance match the reference. |
| `execution_result` step 1, line 5, characters [0,224257) | The controller reports `ok: true`, no error, a saved render, and 1,735 scene primitives, including 1,276 floor primitives and 365 chaise primitives. This is **formal execution success**, not visual or geometric correctness. The supplied line reports a completed render but does not expose the image itself. |
| `select`, line 6; student `codex_session`, line 2 | Step 1 was selected. The visible first session had zero tool calls; its code is evidence of autonomous construction within the supplied procedure, not a visible iterative exploration or render comparison. No student inspection, diagnosis, revision or final completion response is shown in this chunk. |

**Teacher input and adoption:** No teacher event is visible in this chunk. The extensive reconstruction procedure was present in the student’s system request (line 1); its presence is not evidence of a separate teacher intervention or of adoption from one. There is therefore no visible teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, receipt, or execution of such an update.

**Outcome and lessons:** The observed outcome is one successful execution and selection; overall task correctness and any later outcome are **unknown**, not established partial visual correctness or algorithm failure. Grouping parts with their trim and checking material descendants are transferable construction practices evidenced in the code; the chaise ledger, parquet and camera values are task-specific hypotheses. Whether the scene’s connections, occlusions, framing, lighting and textures actually match remains unresolved. The other three chunks and both images were not available for this audit.
